resources.string: Locally sends glucose, the original timestamp, trend and delta per minute in xDrip format. Works with both phone readings and readings relayed from the watch. Only valid readings less than 6 minutes old are sent.
Off by default. When enabled, compatible apps can receive your glucose data. If no recipients are specified, any app listening for this broadcast can receive it.
Example: com.example.glucose. Separate multiple packages with spaces or commas.
Enter valid package names, for example com.example.glucose.

Leave blank for all compatible apps. If the receiving app does not get data in the background, enter its package name and save. Changes apply immediately; the latest valid reading is sent again with its original timestamp.

Enable xDrip broadcast reception in the app that will display glucose. The transmitted value is always in mg/dL; the receiving app can display mmol/L. The timestamp is preserved to calculate reading age. If data stops arriving, the receiving app must mark the reading as stale.
